evidence_scope: Local files and git objects only; no production or browser verification

method.inventory: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 JSON rows (path, bytes, sha256), compact separators, no trailing newline
method.similarity: Same-path JS only; difflib.SequenceMatcher on splitlines(), autojunk=False; 2*matched/(left+right)
limitations: Not a whole-product or legal similarity score
No fuzzy comparison across renamed paths
No image perceptual comparison or source ownership conclusion
Git source projection is not execution of the build or proof of production deployment
